free_tier_limits: Starter: no charge, maximum 5 connections, unlimited data access, and 1,000 API calls per day per connected organisation.
rate_limits: Per tenant: 5 concurrent calls, 60 calls/minute, and 1,000 calls/day on Starter or 5,000 calls/day on higher tiers; plus 10,000 calls/minute app-wide across all tenants.
description: Xero Accounting API provides OAuth 2.0 access to invoices, contacts, payments, bank transactions, accounts, and reports across connected organisations. It supports accounting integrations and bookkeeping automation but does not expose unreconciled bank-statement data or permit bank-statement-line reconciliation through the public Accounting API.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Corrected from current pricing: https://developer.xero.com/pricing. rate_limits: Corrected to the published tenant and app-wide limits: https://developer.xero.com/documentation/best-practices/api-call-efficiencies/rate-limits. description: Corrected because reconciliation must occur in Xero and unreconciled statement data is not public: https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/accounting/bankstatements.
